hypotheses.B0_rank16_is_finitely_sufficient: Mean plus 16 modes predicts one-sided scale-0.5 MLP-path coordinate effects with fidelity at least 0.85 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B1_rank32_is_high_fidelity: Mean plus 32 modes reaches coordinate fidelity at least 0.89 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B2_rank32_recovers_sparse_grammar_change: Rank 32 predicts selected-edge changes with fidelity at least 0.85 and full restricted-coefficient changes with fidelity at least 0.85 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B3_outliers_beat_equal_size_bulk: Mean plus modes 1-16 exceeds mean plus modes 17-32 by at least 0.05 coordinate fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.B4_causal_sufficiency_is_rotation_invari: A random rotation of the top-16 modes changes reconstructed finite responses by maximum absolute error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.B5_rank32_predicts_native_transport: Rank 32 predicts complete native finite coordinate responses with fidelity at least 0.85 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B6_leading_modes_are_necessary_for_compa: Deleting modes 1-16 from the rank-128 dictionary reduces coordinate fidelity by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
